paragraphs: Rav Idi bar Gershom said in Rabbi Adda bar Ahavah’s name, Keritot 9a. In Rabbi Levi ben Perata’s name in Rabbi Nachum’s name in Rabbi Bira’s name, from an elder named Rabbi Yaakov. Jerusalem Talmud, Terumot, chapter 10, halakhah 10: Adda ben Gershon; Rabbi Ze'ira, Rabbi Birei, Rabbi Levi bar Palta, an elder in Rabbi’s name. Rav Shemen bar Abba said in his name, Chullin 98a.
